sentences.text: Tower and airport duty coordination establishes the working link between live control positions, the airport duty desk, surface surveillance feeds, and operational safety checks.
The Tower Supervisor remains accountable for control tower coordination and keeps the Airport Duty Manager informed of conditions that may affect runway, taxiway, stand, or apron availability.
For this section only, Brindle is the operational alias used by Tower Supervisor during voice coordination drills.

The Airport Duty Manager maintains the airport duty desk as the single operational point for airport status confirmation during Normal Operations, Adverse Weather Mode, Capacity Reduction State, and Recovery Phase.
The duty desk reviews tower inputs, airport operations reports, and surveillance indications before confirming whether a local condition should be reflected in the Airport Capacity Plan.
The Surface Surveillance Adapter consolidates position updates from the East Apron Sensor and West Apron Sensor and presents movement indications to the Airport CDM Portal.
The Tower Sequence Manager uses validated surface status to support local sequencing decisions without replacing controller judgment or established radio procedures.
The Airport Duty Manager uses the Runway Inspection Note to confirm that the duty desk has a current record of pavement status before endorsing any declared capacity change.
Orchard shall issue time-stamped weather condition updates for use in tower and airport duty coordination.
When surveillance data conflicts with tower observations, the Tower Supervisor and Airport Duty Manager agree on the operational interpretation before the condition is shared more widely.
The Ramp Control Lead reviews apron movement constraints with the duty desk when stand access, pushback flow, or tug routing affects the departure plan.
The Airport CDM Portal records duty desk confirmations as operational annotations linked to the relevant runway, taxiway, apron, or stand area.
The Collaborative Decision Log captures the time, origin, and rationale for each local coordination decision that affects capacity or surface flow.
The Time Synchronization Service shall keep tower, duty desk, surveillance, and portal event times aligned so that later review can reconstruct the sequence of events.
Surface surveillance feeds are treated as advisory evidence for airport duty decisions unless the competent controller or airport authority confirms the operational effect.
The Tower Supervisor verifies that any proposed reduction in declared runway use is consistent with observed traffic, controller workload, and the current safety position.
The Airport Duty Manager verifies that airfield operations checks have been completed before requesting changes to Airport Acceptance Rate values or departure metering assumptions.
The Regional Flow Platform receives confirmed capacity impacts through normal system interfaces after local duty coordination has established the airport position.
The Capacity Assessment Module may use the confirmed airport position to recalculate available capacity, but it does not originate local airfield safety judgments.
The Alert Distribution Hub distributes approved duty coordination alerts to affected operational roles when a local condition changes runway availability, taxi routing, or apron access.
The Identity Access Service restricts entry of duty desk confirmations to authorized airport operations staff and records each transaction in the Audit Event Ledger.
If the Airport CDM Portal is unavailable, the Contingency Operations Console provides a degraded channel for recording tower and duty desk decisions until normal service is restored.
During shift handover, the outgoing Airport Duty Manager briefs open safety checks, unresolved surveillance discrepancies, and any tower coordination points that remain active.

After operations, the Performance Analytics Warehouse compares recorded duty coordination events with actual movement data to identify delays, missed checks, and opportunities to improve local decision quality.
